pages.name: Scotch: 4.Nxd4 Bc5 5.Be3 Qf6 6.c3 Nge7 7.Bc4 Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 3 named 'key squares like d5 and c5', read as moves; rewrote it around the supported d4-knight and Nb3 against the c5-bishop.

pages.name: Scotch: 4.Nxd4 Bc5 5.Nb3 Bb6 6.a4
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White castling long with the c1-bishop, b1-knight and queen at home; now Nc3-d5 against the b6-bishop and short castling. Plan 1 notes a5 hits the bishop. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Scotch: 4.Nxd4 Bc5 5.Nxc6 Qf6 6.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Be3 and long castling with the queen on d2 blocking the c1-bishop (rejected once in a rewrite that kept it); now Nc3, Bd3 and O-O. Plan 2 had ...Be7 for a bishop on c5; now ...Ne7, ...Be6 and castling.

pages.name: Scotch: 4.Nxd4 Bc5 5.Nxc6 Qf6 6.Qd2 dxc6 7.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the queen to 'e3', read as a pawn move; now Qf4 offering a queen trade. '0-0' notation in plans 1 and 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Scotch: Mieses, 6...Qe7 7.Qe2
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a knight from d7 (it is on f6, attacked by e5); rewrote it around ...Nd5, ...Nb6 or ...Ba6. Plan 3's d-file is half-open, not open. British spelling in the overview, plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Three Knights: 3...Bb4 4.Nd5
pages.notes: The overview called the c6-knight pinned (nothing pins it; the d5-knight attacks the b4-bishop and c7); plan 2 had ...Bxd5 and ...c6 with a knight on c6; plan 3 had f2-f4 behind the f3-knight. Rewrote all three. British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Three Knights: 3...d6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...exd4 before White has played d4; rewrote it. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Halloween Gambit, Plasma Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3's 'Nc7+' in Black's plan reworded. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Scotch Variation, Belgrade Gambit, Modern Defense
pages.notes: The overview said White sacrificed a pawn (Black is two pawns up); plan 2 had ...d5 with White's knight on d5. Rewrote both, adding the critical 7.Ng5 d3! 8.cxd3 Nd4 (a first rewrite without it was rejected as missing the main idea). British spelling in plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Four Knights: Belgrade Gambit, 5...Nxe4
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...d5 with White's knight on d5; rewrote it. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.
